content.short: Uniswap's self-custody wallet for swapping, bridging and earning across 20+ networks.
content.description: Uniswap Wallet, from Uniswap Labs, puts the largest on-chain marketplace in a mobile app and Chrome extension. Users swap thousands of tokens with MEV protection on by default, bridge between networks such as Unichain, World Chain, Base and Arbitrum, buy crypto with a card or bank, and earn yield on USDC, USDT and ETH. Setup needs no name, email or phone number, and it has over 62,000 reviews averaging 4.8.
content.meta: Swap, bridge and earn across 20+ networks with Uniswap Wallet, with MEV protection and no signup details needed.
